patch_description: The current controller uses archive/mean difficulty weights of 0.65/0.35, stagnation smoothing of 0.18, a 0.012 width floor, and expansion/contraction rates of 0.45/0.20. This proposal incorporates best fitness, lowers the floor to 0.003, and accelerates contraction to 0.35 to support precise refinement. Exploration increases when positive progress stalls and population diversity falls; archive deterioration triggers feedback-driven recovery. Archive-relative success provides a modest adjustment. These changes target stronger acquisition and previous-task performance, but require evaluation.
